name: session-bookmarks
description: Explicit bookmarks for Claude Code sessions you want to come back to. /bm saves one, /bm open lists them with a copyable resume command.

bookmarksFile.title: Bookmarks file
bookmarksFile.description: Where bookmarks are kept as JSON. Empty means ~/.claude/bookmarks/bookmarks.json. The SESSION_BOOKMARKS_FILE environment variable wins over this.

titleModel.title: Title model
titleModel.description: Model alias for the one short call that writes a title when /bm gets no note.
